contract.application_relevance: Workers construct ordinary text requests and responses that downstream clients interpret by their media type.
contract.cleanup: Every case is awaited before cleanup. Track explicit readers and body streams; cancel/release readers, initiate all unlocked-stream cancellations before joining them, and retain no request-local objects. Buffered body producers may be lazy; explicit JS stream producers are finite and close synchronously. Cleanup records runtime-retained locks with awaited consumer/descendant proof, and any unverified lock blocks acceptance. No open producer gates, external handles or timers are used. Await both Y220 consumers with allSettled. If a body method or cleanup does not settle within the external deadline, supervisor terminates only the owned process group and records failure/unknown plus incomplete cleanup. It never reports a pass.
contract.desired_behavior: Implicit string bodies infer text/plain;charset=UTF-8; explicit text/x-fixture remains; all bytes spell hello.
contract.distinctness: Scalar-string extraction and MIME inference, separate from URLSearchParams typed-form dispatch and JSON static helper.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(inferred.headers.get('content-type'), 'text/plain;charset=UTF-8', 'string Response BodyInit infers text media type');
t.equal(request.headers.get('content-type'), 'text/plain;charset=UTF-8', 'string Request BodyInit infers text media type');
t.equal(explicit.headers.get('content-type'), 'text/x-fixture', 'explicit content type takes precedence over inferred type');
t.equal(await t.consume(inferred, 'text'), 'hello', 'inference does not alter string body');
t.equal(await t.consume(request, 'text'), 'hello', 'request extraction retains string bytes');
t.equal(await t.consume(explicit, 'text'), 'hello', 'explicit media type does not transcode body');
contract.hypothesis: The string extraction fast path may omit the standard text media type or overwrite an explicitly supplied type.
contract.mechanism: String BodyInit default content-type and caller override precedence

Native celld Blob, File, FormData, Request, Response, and ReadableStream globals; no mocks or implementation extraction.
External five-second case deadline plus independent 300-second suite deadline and owned cleanup are active.
